ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution. Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels, predominantly appearing as dense mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pixels are concentrated in a dense, contiguous patch around the median notch, radiating outward in irregular, speckled patterns. High-intensity pixels dominate the outer two-thirds of both lobes, punctuated by thousands of small, low-intensity circular rings.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 55 degrees with a deep, narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration. The boundary exhibits a 'sawtooth' pattern with irregular peak heights ranging from 3 to 12 pixels across the entire trailing span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the upper trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extreme density of circular, high-contrast rings (dark circumference with light centers) distributed across the entire ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, partially obscured by the rosette scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of calcified, high-intensity white structures (living barnacles) are visible on the right distal tip and along the superior edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The fluke exhibits a rare, near-total coverage of circular barnacle attachment scars, creating a 'leopard-print' texture across the pigmentation.
